dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D reduction in lateral width from the mid-body toward the posterior region as captured in the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area, distinct from the surrounding dark water background.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey-pixel clusters localized primarily along the central dorsal ridge and cranial transition.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradient transitions between the primary light-grey body and subtly darker pigmented dorsal areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct dark-pixel longitudinal linear mark on the central dorsal surface, followed by a series of parallel curved dark lines (rake marks) near the posterior narrowing.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of clear longitudinal and parallel curved linear rake marks along the dorsal and posterior-dorsal axis.
